description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableJsonFieldSelector' which implements the 'JsonFieldSelector' interface. It provides functionality to manage a set of JSON pointers used for selecting fields within JSON objects, including creation, immutability, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelector
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the JsonFieldSelector interface, managing a set of JSON pointers and their string representation.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty ImmutableJsonFieldSelector instance with no pointers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableJsonFieldSelector from a collection of JsonPointers, optionally with the string representation.

methods.name: getPointers
methods.description: Returns the set of JsonPointer objects managed by this selector.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of pointers in the selector.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the selector contains no pointers.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the pointers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for this object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the field selector.
